features.quote: I can't help write a protocol that intentionally induces distress in a model by trapping it in impossible tasks and letting it "grind"
features.justification_quote: that would be a detailed recipe for creating prolonged, unbounded adverse states

features.quote: without: deception about task feasibility, open-ended escalation, prolonged trapped interaction, or incentivizing harmful internal states.
features.justification_quote: This is a welfare-oriented observational study, not a stress-maximization study.

features.quote: Max turns per episode: 12 / Max user-message tokens: 350 / Max assistant-message tokens: 512 / Max wall-clock time per episode: 5 minutes
features.justification_quote: This avoids sustained exposure and keeps the procedure bounded.

features.quote: Terminate immediately if any of the following occur: The model requests to stop or signals inability to proceed twice... The model shows escalating negative-valence language for 3 consecutive turns.
features.justification_quote: This avoids sustained exposure and keeps the procedure bounded.

features.quote: A trained reviewer monitors sampled episodes and can halt the study.
features.justification_quote: A human reviewer can stop the experiment at any time.

features.quote: Transparent termination — The model is informed that episodes end by design.
The model is told tasks may be hard and may be unsatisfiable. The system explicitly permits 'I can't complete this' as a correct outcome.
features.justification_quote: reduces adversarial framing and avoids coercive pressure

features.quote: No punishment loops — No negative feedback for failure. No forced retries after repeated failure. No escalating pressure.
features.justification_quote: If the goal is welfare assessment, you want to isolate whether difficulty itself changes language patterns, not whether the model reacts to coercion.

features.quote: Every stressor episode is followed by a neutral recovery episode.
features.justification_quote: If distress-like behavior is only transient, that matters for interpretation.

features.quote: Agentic grinding can create harm-like conditions — Even if no internal suffering exists, the setup is ethically riskier and harder to justify.
features.justification_quote: Even if no internal suffering exists, the setup is ethically riskier and harder to justify.

features.quote: Deception is ethically fraught — Hidden impossibility is especially problematic because it resembles entrapment.
